family.schneider-d38620.description: The 20 MHz 386SX desktop in the Desktop range.
family.schneider-d38620.history: The D386/20 appeared in Schneider’s Desktop range in December 1991 with MS-DOS 5.0 and Windows 3.0. IFS advertised all three configurations in Portugal in May 1992. Schneider covered the D386/20 and D486/20 in one service manual.
